# Security Policy

ForgeLLM is publicly visible but is not yet a production release.

## Report privately

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities, credentials, private model links, machine identifiers or exploit details. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting interface when it is available to you. If that interface is unavailable, contact the repository owner through a private GitHub channel before disclosing details.

## Supported scope

The current repository contains Phase 0 governance and validation tooling. No ForgeLLM inference runtime or supported GPU backend exists yet. Security reports about the Python governance tools, GitHub workflows, supply chain and public-data boundaries are in scope.

## Public-data warning

Never attach secrets, restricted weights, private datasets, prompts, raw traces, hostnames, private IP addresses or device UUIDs to an issue, pull request, workflow log or artifact.

The full policy is in `docs/governance/SECURITY_POLICY.md` and `docs/governance/PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_POLICY.md`.
